name: avenue_lanes
author: netmod (task avcore)
description: One-way avenue halves (owner 2026-10-19: 2 lanes each way, right-hand traffic everywhere). sc3netmod's AVL block writes these on an avenue band it can convert whole (re/analysis/AVENUE_LANES.md): 21700 the straight half (base 11204, both lanes in the half's direction), 21701 the avenue end U-turn quarter (base 11203). Both save as their base at the same state, so a game without the mod loads the stock avenue.
